newsitem.title: FRANCE: AIDS cases seen decreasing in France.
newsitem.headline: AIDS cases seen decreasing in France.

text.p: The number of people developing full-blown AIDS continued to decrease in France in the first half of this year, the health ministry said on Tuesday.

It put the number of new AIDS cases reported between January and June at 2,507. If the trend remained constant for the rest of this year, it would amount to 5,014 cases, compared with 5,469 last year and 5,789 in 1994.
